town_description: Mansa is the district headquarters town in the Malwa region of Punjab, an agricultural market town in the cotton belt. It has its own railway station and is the commercial centre of the district; nearest airport is Bathinda, about 60 km away.

travel.railway: Mansa railway station under Northern Railways; direct trains to Delhi, Mumbai, Howrah, Bathinda (mansa.nic.in).
travel.road: Direct buses/AC coaches to Sirsa (70 km), Bathinda (60 km), Chandigarh (180 km), Patiala (108 km) (mansa.nic.in).
